dish: House-brewed ales with traditional English pub fare
w: A three-decade staple of downtown Carlisle and an anchor of the Cumberland Valley Beer Trail — English-style pub brewing its own beers on site.

dish: The Hot-Chee Dog — grilled dog, American cheese, house chili, yellow mustard and diced onions, served since 1938
w: Downtown Carlisle diner on the old 'Greek Row,' widely regarded as the town's oldest continuously operating restaurant; Greek immigrant Charles Kollas created the Hot-Chee Dog here in 1938, and it now has its own historical marker. Winner of the 2023 Cumberland Valley Meal Madness bracket.

dish: Farm-fresh chocolate milk and batch-churned Kreider Farms ice cream at the end of the dairy tour
w: A 90-year-old working dairy: May–October trolley tours through the 'Moo-ternity' barn and calving corner, the rotary 'Cowrousel' milking parlor and a 100-foot silo observation tower.

dish: Fruit and grape wines from Adams County orchards — the Gettysburg area's original winery (1975)
w: Pennsylvania's fifth-oldest operating winery and a ten-time 'Best Winery' in the Gettysburg's Greatest readers' awards, in a bank barn in the fruit belt west of town; tasting room also on Gettysburg's square.

dish: Award-winning vodka, rums and corn whiskey distilled in Gettysburg
w: Gettysburg distillery (2016) in a former factory; named Pennsylvania Vodka Distillery of the Year at the 2018 New York International Spirits Competition and a Gettysburg's Greatest winner.
